messages.subject: Robust fit indices with WLSMV
parts:
Hello, 
I am fitting a model with DWLS estimator for my categorical data (4-point Likert scale). In tutorial file, I see a quote saying " For the DWLS and ULS estimators, lavaan also provides ‘robust’ variants: WLSM, WLSMVS, WLSMV, ULSM, ULSMVS, ULSMV. "  So, I understand that part. However, my question is that do we need to report Robust RMSEA, CFI, and TLI indices when we used  WLSMV? If yes, how can I get them since the lavaan just report them as NA in default? 
Thanks
